title: Carve AST interchange envelope
description: A versioned wrapper for a Carve AST at a STORAGE OR PROCESS BOUNDARY. The document inside it is exactly the tree `ast-schema.json` describes, unchanged: `carve --json` still emits that tree bare, and an in-memory handoff still passes it bare. The envelope exists so a reader that cannot read a payload can say WHY - a newer contract, a missing capability, or a corrupt tree - where a strict-closed schema with no version answers all three with one validation error (PART 12 section 33, carve#2199).

astVersion.description: The INTERCHANGE CONTRACT version, `major.minor`. It is NOT the Carve language version and does not track it: the language is versioned for authors, this is versioned for readers of a tree. A major bump removes, renames or reinterprets a field; a minor bump adds a field or a node type. Current: 1.0.

vocabulary.description: The node vocabulary the document is written in. Absent means the core vocabulary, `https://markup-carve.org/ast/core`. A profile that denies types does NOT change it - a denied type is one the document does not use, not a different vocabulary.

extensions.description: The extensions whose node types or fields the document uses. A reader that does not implement one listed as `required` refuses the payload and names it, rather than rendering the parts it understands and reporting success - which is what section 9(b) forbids one level down.

id.description: Globally qualified identifier, so two extensions cannot collide.

version.description: The extension's own version, opaque to this schema.

required.description: Whether the document's MEANING depends on it. Absent means true. An extension a reader may ignore without misreading the document sets it false - a reader that drops a required one has rendered a different document and said nothing.

document.description: The tree, exactly as `ast-schema.json` describes it.
